# OTLP Protobuf Golden Test Fixtures

Binary protobuf payloads for contract verification of the hand-built OTLP
protobuf encoder (`src/transport-otlp/otlp-protobuf-encoder.ts`).

These files are **generated by the encoder itself** — not hand-crafted — so
they serve as a deterministic check: if the encoder output changes (whether
intentionally or via regression), these golden files change too and the diff
must be reviewed.

## Files

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `minimal-logrecord.bin` | Simplest valid LogRecord: INFO severity, string body, no attributes, no trace |
| `logrecord-with-trace.bin` | Minimal LogRecord with W3C trace correlation (traceId, spanId, flags) |
| `logrecord-full.bin` | Maximal LogRecord: ERROR severity, attributes (intValue + boolValue), full trace context |
| `empty-batch.bin` | LogsData with zero ResourceLogs — produces 0 bytes |

## Regeneration

If the encoder logic changes, regenerate these fixtures from the repo root:

```sh
npx tsx tests/fixtures/otlp-protobuf-golden/generate.ts
```

(The generator script is ephemeral — it is deleted after each run to avoid
drift. Keep a copy of the import/request structure from VCS history if you
need to recreate it.)
